trickyParts: nats.go's legacy KeyValue Get/Delete take no context, so role_holder.go bounds them with withinContext (goroutine + select on ctx.Done(), the streamInfoWithin pattern). An abandoned conditional release can still land after the 503/500; that is safe because it deletes only the exact revision whose holder was just found gone.

unplaceableDeferralExpiry = unplaceableRetryDelay + 2 × consumerAckWait = 125 s: NAK delay, an AckWait for a lost NAK, and an AckWait of margin for the redelivery to reach the handler. A message pending longer loses its slot early and the set undercounts by one until its delivery.
GET /v1/roles/<role> answers only the race 503; a role store that does not answer within the budget stays 500 there, as before, now naming the call.
